text:
[Council File 25-0400]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
HOUSING COMMITTEE REPORT relative to authorizing loan amendments and/or new loans for the purpose of stabilizing eight affordable housing projects with outstanding City loans, and obligate and disburse Los Angeles County Affordable Housing Solutions Agency (LACAHSA) funds.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. FIND that, for any new contracts signed to support the projects identified in Table 1 of the Housing Department (LAHD) revised report dated November 12, 2026 (report), attached to the Council file, there is a basis to enter into sole source contracts pursuant to: (i) Los Angeles City Charter Section 371(e)(5), as there is “urgent necessity for the preservation of life, health or property”; and (ii) Los Angeles City Charter Section 371(e)(10), as it is “undesirable, impractical or impossible” for such new contracts to be competitively bid, with the basis for these findings further detailed in the LAHD revised report.
2. AUTHORIZE the General Manager, LAHD, or designee, to:
a. Expend and disburse up to $14,042,247 (Fiscal Year 2025-26) from Fund No. 69A, Account No. 43CD66, in LACAHSA funds, consistent with planned expenditures as described in the LAHD revised report.
b. Disburse protective advances under existing contracts and/or enter into new sole source contracts to pay off or purchase senior debt, disburse protective advances, fund emergency life-safety repairs, fund operating expenses or capital improvements, or provide relocation assistance, for the identified projects and in amounts not to exceed those shown in Table 2 of the LAHD revised report.
c. Combine Broadway Village I and Broadway Village II into a single scattered-site loan new agreement, and to consolidate the revenues, expenses, and loan obligations of the two sites; to consolidate the two existing LAHD regulatory agreements into a single regulatory agreement covering both sites; to approve the assignment and assumption of the existing LAHD loans on the Broadway Village I and Broadway Village II sites to the new ownership entity; and to replace the existing 5.08 percent compounding interest rate on the assumed LAHD debt with an Applicable Federal Rate-based rate.
d. Negotiate and execute:
i. An amended regulatory agreement with Broadway Village GP LLC regarding Broadway Village I and Broadway Village II, subject to the review and approval by the City Attorney as to form, to amend the regulatory agreement as follows: (1) Modify the rent limits to align with the California Tax Credit Allocation Committee award, to an amount that does not exceed 60 percent of Area Median Income (U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development); (2) Extend the term of the regulatory agreement to mature on or after 55 years.
ii. New and/or amended loan documents (including loan agreements, promissory notes, regulatory agreements, and any other applicable documents) as necessary to fund and administer the projects as further specified in the LAHD revised report, subject to the review and approval of the City Attorney as to form.
e. Substitute or replace the LACAHSA Eligible Jurisdiction funding source identified in the LAHD revised report with any other eligible funding source, should circumstances require.
f. Subordinate LAHD’s loans to other project lenders, where such action is recommended in the LAHD revised report for a particular project.
3. AUTHORIZE the Controller to obligate and disburse funds for the following projects from LACAHSA Fund No. 69A upon proper demand of the General Manager, LAHD, or designee, for those projects and in those amounts listed below, under Fund 69A, Account 43CD66-PPO-PL-Prod Presv Ownership Flexible:
a. Project Name: Broadway Village I and Broadway Village II; Amount: $700,000; Loan Number:
BA0379 and (1) CRA872513-003, (2) BA0396.
b. Project Name: Central City Apartments; Amount: $4,461,412; Loan Number: 980220-002.
c. Project Name: Eastside Village Family Housing; Amount: $3,809,835; Loan Number:
CRA872400-002.
d. Project Name: Pascual Reyes Apartments; Amount: $467,500; Loan Number: CRA872501-002.
e. Project Name: The Brine Residential; Amount: $2,086,376; Loan Number: 18-125506-001 and 18-125506-002.
f. Project Name: FAME
i. Gardens; Amount: $1,360,512; Loan Number: CRA871771-002
ii. Manor; Amount: $1,156,612; Loan Number: BA0185
4. DIRECT the LAHD to report to the Mayor and City Council on any eligible funding substitution made as a result of the authority provided in this report.
5. AUTHORIZE the General Manager, LAHD, or designee, to prepare Controller instructions and any necessary technical adjustments consistent with Mayor and City Council actions, subject to the approval of the City Administrative Officer (CAO), and instruct the Controller to implement the instructions.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The LAHD reports that there is no impact to the General Fund. Neither the CAO nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Authority for loan amendments and/or new loans to stabilize eight affordable housing projects that already have City loans, using Los Angeles County Affordable Housing Solutions Agency funds.
